title: How an upload becomes a thumbnail
mechanism: The API hands each upload to a queue, and a worker takes the jobs off it one at a time.
claim: The API answers before the slow work starts, so an upload never waits on it.
implication: When thumbnails fall behind, add workers, not API servers.

beats.title: Answer first
beats.plain: The API hands the job to a queue and replies right away.
beats.technical: POST /upload enqueues a resize job and returns 202 before any image work runs.

beats.title: Work later
beats.plain: A worker picks the job up when it is free and makes the thumbnail.
beats.technical: The resizer takes one job from the queue and resizes the image off the request path.

beats.title: Keep the result
beats.plain: The finished thumbnail is saved where the app can find it.
beats.technical: The worker writes the thumbnail to the object store under the upload's key.
